sections.title: Gynaecology (Ten Teachers Gynaecology, 20th ed.)
chapters: Development and anatomy of the female sexual organs and pelvis (congenital anomalies, Mullerian anomalies, DSD)
Gynaecological history, examination and investigations (USS, hysteroscopy, laparoscopy, HSG, biopsy)
Hormonal control of the menstrual cycle and hormonal disorders (puberty, amenorrhoea, PCOS, hirsutism, hyperprolactinaemia, premature ovarian insufficiency)
Disorders of menstrual bleeding (HMB, dysmenorrhoea, PMS, intermenstrual bleeding, DUB)
Implantation and early pregnancy (miscarriage, ectopic pregnancy, molar pregnancy and GTD, hyperemesis, pregnancy of unknown location)
Contraception and abortion (all contraceptive methods, sterilisation, emergency contraception, termination of pregnancy)
Subfertility (male and female factors, investigations, ovulation induction, IVF and ART, OHSS)
The menopause and postreproductive health (HRT, osteoporosis, postmenopausal bleeding)
Genitourinary problems (STIs, PID, vaginal discharge, bacterial vaginosis, candidiasis, trichomoniasis, genital tuberculosis, urinary tract problems)
Urogynaecology and pelvic floor problems (prolapse, urinary incontinence, fistulae, pessaries)
Benign conditions of the ovary and pelvis (ovarian cysts and tumours benign, endometriosis, adenomyosis, chronic pelvic pain, adhesions)
Benign conditions of the uterus, cervix and endometrium (fibroids, polyps, endometrial hyperplasia, cervical ectropion)
Benign conditions of the vulva and vagina, psychosexual disorders and FGM (lichen sclerosus, Bartholin, dyspareunia, vaginismus)
Malignant disease of the uterus (endometrial cancer, sarcoma)
Premalignant and malignant disease of the lower genital tract (CIN, cervical cancer, screening, HPV, VIN, vulval and vaginal cancer)
Gynaecological surgery and therapeutics (hysterectomy, operations, complications, pre- and post-operative care, drugs, radiotherapy)
Other gynaecology topics not in the contents list (miscellaneous gynaecology, ethics, paediatric gynaecology not elsewhere)

notes: Routing rules (Ten Teachers): 1) Ectopic pregnancy, miscarriage (all types), molar pregnancy/GTD, hyperemesis gravidarum, early pregnancy USS -> Y5 (Gynae book ch5), not Obs. 2) Contraception (COCP, POP, IUCD, implant, depot, emergency) and medical or surgical termination of pregnancy, sterilisation -> Y6. 3) Postpartum contraception and lactational amenorrhoea -> Y6 unless the point is breastfeeding physiology -> O15. 4) Antepartum haemorrhage (praevia, abruption, vasa praevia), PROM/PPROM, polyhydramnios, oligohydramnios, malpresentation in late pregnancy, post-term, Rh isoimmunisation, stillbirth/IUFD -> O6. 5) PPH (all types), cord prolapse, shoulder dystocia, uterine rupture, amniotic fluid embolism, inversion, maternal collapse, shock in obstetrics -> O14. 6) Preterm labour, tocolytics, antenatal steroids, magnesium for neuroprotection -> O8; PPROM goes to O6. 7) Pre-eclampsia, eclampsia, HELLP, MgSO4 regimen, gestational hypertension, chronic hypertension in pregnancy -> O9. 8) Diabetes, cardiac disease, anaemia, thyroid, epilepsy, renal, liver, VTE, SLE/APS, asthma in pregnancy -> O10 (recurrent miscarriage due to APS: Y5). 9) TORCH, HIV, HBV/HCV, GBS, malaria, syphilis, varicella, UTI in pregnancy -> O11; STIs and PID in the non-pregnant -> Y9. 10) Partograph, stages of labour, mechanism, induction, augmentation, analgesia, malposition, obstructed or prolonged labour, breech delivery, twins in labour -> O12 (twin pregnancy antenatal: O7). 11) Forceps, ventouse, caesarean, VBAC, episiotomy, perineal tears -> O13. 12) Neonatal resuscitation, neonatal jaundice, neonatal sepsis, birth injuries, APGAR -> O16. 13) Puerperal sepsis, postnatal depression, lactation, breastfeeding drugs -> O15. 14) Normal pelvis anatomy, female genital tract embryology and Mullerian anomalies, DSD, Turner, testicular feminisation -> Y1; bony pelvis in obstetrics (pelvic types, diameters, engagement) -> O1. 15) Primary and secondary amenorrhoea, PCOS, hirsutism, hyperprolactinaemia, puberty, menstrual cycle physiology -> Y3; HMB, dysmenorrhoea, PMS -> Y4. 16) Fibroids, endometrial polyp, hyperplasia -> Y12; endometriosis, adenomyosis, benign ovarian cysts, PID sequelae, chronic pelvic pain -> Y11; endometrial cancer -> Y15; ovarian cancer and tumour markers -> Y14; cervical screening, CIN, HPV, cervical/vulval/vaginal cancer -> Y16. 17) Prolapse, incontinence, fistulae -> Y10; menopause, HRT, osteoporosis, postmenopausal bleeding -> Y8. 18) Subfertility, IVF, ovulation induction, OHSS -> Y7. 19) Hysterectomy, laparoscopy complications, perioperative care, gynae drugs, radiotherapy -> Y17. 20) Use OX/YX for real O&G topics outside the list (ethics, statistics, maternal mortality); use OM/YM only for junk or if nothing fits.
